# Date setting controls

Date and time fields.

(api-gui-forms-datetimepicker)=
## DateTimePicker

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/date_time_picker/date_time_picker.hpp>
class DateTimePicker final : public Panel
```

DateTimePicker is a retained civil date/time field with validated bounds, four formatting policies, caller-supplied format vocabulary, optional check state, calendar or spin presentation, configurable popup alignment, source-private transient ownership, keyboard/pointer/semantic control, and ordered typed events.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `DateTimePicker`.

**Members**

| --- | --- |

| `DateTimeValue value() const noexcept` | Returns the authoritative constrained civil date/time value. |
| `void set_value(DateTimeValue value)` | Validates the civil value, clamps to the admitted range, and publishes a real change. |
| `DateTimeValue minimum() const noexcept` | Returns the inclusive earliest admitted civil value. |
| `DateTimeValue maximum() const noexcept` | Returns the inclusive latest admitted civil value. |
| `void set_range(DateTimeValue minimum, DateTimeValue maximum)` | Validates both civil values and chronological order, constrains current value, and refreshes popup/semantics coherently. |

(api-gui-forms-datetimeformatprovider)=
## DateTimeFormatProvider

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/date_time_picker/date_time_format_provider/date_time_format_provider.hpp>
struct DateTimeFormatProvider final
```

DateTimeFormatProvider is an immutable caller-substitutable vocabulary and pattern bundle for DateTimePicker formatting. It separates locale-shaped presentation from civil-value authority without introducing a platform locale runtime dependency.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `static DateTimeFormatProvider english_united_states()` | Returns the library's canonical English month/day names and short, long, time, and month-year patterns. |

**Data members**

```cpp
std::array<std::string, 12> month_names;
std::array<std::string, 12> abbreviated_month_names;
std::array<std::string, 7> day_names;
std::array<std::string, 7> abbreviated_day_names;
std::string long_date_pattern{"dddd, MMMM d, yyyy"};
std::string short_date_pattern{"M/d/yyyy"};
std::string time_pattern{"h:mm tt"};
std::string am_designator{"AM"};
std::string pm_designator{"PM"};
```

(api-gui-forms-datetimevalue)=
## DateTimeValue

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/date_time_picker/date_time_value/date_time_value.hpp>
struct DateTimeValue final
```

DateTimeValue is DateTimePicker's timezone-free civil date/time value. Ordering is lexicographic across validated year-through-second fields so range constraint and calendar selection remain deterministic.

**Data members**

```cpp
std::int32_t year{2000};
std::uint8_t month{1U};
std::uint8_t day{1U};
std::uint8_t hour{};
std::uint8_t minute{};
std::uint8_t second{};
std::uint16_t millisecond{};
```
